source_title: The End Times Become A Strategic Plan
summary: This August 5, 2025 Propaganda & Co. interview is an early public forecast-stage source for Predictive History as falsifiable stress test, eschatology as action plan, Iran/Hormuz/Odessa sequencing, and Jiang's Taiwan non-invasion wager grounded in China as debt spectacle and managed corruption.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Predictive History connects the past, explains the present, and predicts the future, with failed prediction treated as failure of the model.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The opening method statement is a clean interview recurrence of the Living School rule that history must risk future correction rather than remain protected interpretation.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang updates the Iran timetable, treats U.S. ground troops by the next midterms as conceivable, and later says a Taiwan invasion would make his model wrong.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source explicitly puts Jiang's model under dated, public audit through both a near-term Iran forecast and a categorical Taiwan falsification condition.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Eschatology is not only prophecy about the end but an action plan through which groups try to bring about the history they expect.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview gives one of the clearest public definitions of eschatology as operational script rather than private belief.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Al-Aqsa, red heifers, the Third Temple, Iran, Anatolia, and World War III are presented as a sequence actors may attempt to force.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source adds an earlier dated interview recurrence of the ritual-sequence pressure now tracked across later October 2025 forecast sources.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: America cannot smoothly finish one front and pivot to another because imperial bureaucracy and shock-and-awe habits undermine strategic sequencing.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Ukraine/Odessa section directly supports the sequencing-backfire lens point: visible target order and decayed state capacity make adversaries resist a clean pause.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Chinese development is framed as debt-heavy spectacle and organized corruption that keeps stakeholders quiet while draining durable collective capacity.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The corruption-as-feature passage is not only a China topic; it supports the borderland warning that immoral easy money can buy visible motion while consuming the virtues that make motion durable.

new_lens_seeds.title: Prediction As Falsifiable Prophecy
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A historical or prophetic model becomes responsible when it names future conditions that would expose the model as wrong, turning prophecy into public audit instead of protected mysticism or punditry.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This interview predates the October 2025 Higherside and Stoa interviews while carrying the same mechanism in unusually explicit form: Predictive History is defined by prediction, the Iran timetable is updated, and Taiwan invasion is named as a model-breaking event.

chronology_notes.note: On 2025-08-05, Jiang gives an earlier public formulation of Predictive History as connect-past, explain-present, predict-future, predating the October 2025 interview cluster already flagged for prediction-as-falsifiable-prophecy.

The source is a date-sensitive forecast snapshot: Jiang says U.S. ground troops in Iran before the next midterms are conceivable, rules out a China invasion of Taiwan as model-breaking, and sketches a five-year Iran/Odessa/Europe escalation path.

This August 2025 interview defines eschatology as an action plan before later October 2025 public interviews elaborate the same Al-Aqsa/Iran/false-prophet pressure, making it an earlier chronology anchor for the forecast-stage eschatology cluster.
The source ties the Taiwan non-invasion claim to the Chinese economy as debt spectacle and managed corruption, not only to military balance or national preference.
